title: Very good but lacking some features
body:
I love the app, but there are some features i wish it had. 

1) Please add a Skip option for recurring reminders. Sometimes I intentionally want to skip a task without marking it as completed, and I don’t want that to change the schedule of future reminders

2) Please add the option to repeat reminders based on the completion date instead of the original due date. If I finish a weekly or monthly task a few days late, I want the next reminder to be scheduled from the day I actually completed it.
